Leaf Spot.description: Fungal disease causing circular or irregular spots on leaves

Powdery Mildew.description: Fungal disease appearing as white powdery growth on leaves and stems
prevention: Water at base, not on leaves
Apply preventive fungicides in high-risk periods

Rust.description: Fungal disease causing rust-colored pustules on leaves and stems
organic_treatment: Remove and destroy infected plant parts

Blight.description: Rapid wilting and death of plant tissues

Wilt.description: Plant wilting due to vascular system blockage

Root Rot.description: Decay of root system leading to plant decline

Mosaic Virus.description: Viral disease causing mottled leaf patterns
chemical_treatment: No direct chemical cure for viruses

Downy Mildew.description: Fungal disease with downy growth on leaf undersides
symptoms: Yellow spots on upper leaf surface
